title: Noah Kagan (AppSumo founder) — 'highly recommend' + giving out 10 copies
summary: Noah Kagan — Chief Sumo at AppSumo and a long-time voice in the bootstrapped-founder community — calls Incorruptible 'highly recommend' and offers to mail 10 free copies to commenters.
blockquote: Giving out 10 copies of Eric Ries new book - Incorruptible - highly recommend - Leave a comment and I'll pick 10 people to mail them too!
